blocks.text: FOOTHILLS OF MAHABALESHWAR
CHANNEL PARTNER TERMS & CONDITIONS

Project Name: Foothills of Mahabaleshwar
Project Location: Poladpur, Raigad, Maharashtra
By registering as a Channel Partner for Foothills of Mahabaleshwar, the applicant acknowledges and agrees to the following Terms & Conditions.
1. Channel Partner Registration
All Channel Partners must provide accurate personal, business and contact information during registration.
Registration is subject to verification and approval by the project management.
Upon approval, each Channel Partner will receive a unique Channel Partner ID and access to the Partner Dashboard.
Channel Partners are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of their login credentials.
Registration does not automatically guarantee commission eligibility or exclusive selling rights.
2. Lead Registration & Submission
Channel Partners must submit prospective buyer details through the official Channel Partner Dashboard.
Each lead must include accurate buyer information, including name, contact number and relevant enquiry details.
Channel Partners must obtain the buyer's permission before submitting personal information.
Every accepted lead will be linked to the respective Channel Partner ID for tracking purposes.
False, incomplete, duplicate or unauthorised lead submissions may be rejected.
3. Lead Ownership & Duplicate Leads
Lead ownership will generally be determined based on the first valid lead registration accepted by the system.
If a buyer is already registered with the project or another Channel Partner, the new submission may be identified as a duplicate.
Duplicate leads will be reviewed based on registration timestamps, previous interactions and supporting records.
Lead validity periods and extensions will be governed by the applicable Channel Partner agreement.
Project management will review lead ownership disputes and communicate its decision based on available records and the agreed policy.
4. Site Visit Management
Channel Partners may arrange site visits for their registered prospective buyers in coordination with the authorised project team.
Site visits must be scheduled or recorded through the official system.
The Channel Partner Dashboard will display relevant site visit information and status updates.
A site visit will be marked as completed only after verification by an authorised project representative.
Cancelled, rescheduled and missed visits will be recorded accordingly.
Channel Partners must not submit false site visit confirmations.
5. Commission Eligibility
Channel Partners will be eligible for commission on qualifying sales generated through their accepted and registered leads.
Commission rates and eligibility conditions will be communicated separately through an approved written agreement.
Commission eligibility will depend on valid lead attribution and fulfilment of the agreed transaction conditions.
Lead submission, site visits or initial buyer interest alone do not guarantee commission.
Disputed commission claims will be reviewed according to the applicable Channel Partner agreement.
6. Commission Payment
Commission payments will be processed according to the payment milestones and timelines specified in the Channel Partner agreement.
Channel Partners must provide accurate bank account details and applicable tax information.
Applicable TDS, GST and other statutory requirements will be handled in accordance with prevailing laws.
Commission treatment in cases of booking cancellation, refund or transaction failure will be governed by the written agreement.
The Channel Partner Dashboard may display commission eligibility, payment status and transaction details.
7. Project Pricing & Information
Channel Partners must communicate accurate project information, including location, plot sizes, pricing, land classification and available facilities.
Project pricing and availability may be revised by project management from time to time.
Channel Partners must not promise unauthorised discounts, additional facilities or special benefits.
Partners must not make misleading representations regarding development approvals, land conversion, ownership rights or investment returns.
All property transactions will be subject to applicable laws, documentation, approvals and agreements.
8. Buyer Booking & Payments
All official bookings and property transactions will be handled by the authorised project team.
Booking amounts and property payments must be made only through officially authorised payment channels.
Channel Partners are not permitted to collect buyer payments on behalf of the project without specific written authorisation.
Final plot allocation, booking confirmation and transaction documentation will be managed by the authorised project representatives.
Channel Partners must not issue unofficial booking confirmations or payment receipts on behalf of the project.
9. Marketing & Promotional Activities
Channel Partners are free to independently promote and market Foothills of Mahabaleshwar through their preferred marketing channels and strategies.
Channel Partners may use official project brochures, photographs, videos, logos and other marketing materials.
Channel Partners may also create their own promotional content, social media posts, reels, advertisements, videos and marketing campaigns without requiring prior approval from project management.
Channel Partners may independently promote the project through Instagram, Facebook, Google Ads, YouTube, WhatsApp, property portals, websites, offline advertising and their professional networks.
All marketing communications must contain accurate project information, including location, plot details, pricing and applicable conditions.
Channel Partners must not make false or misleading claims, promise guaranteed investment returns or offer unauthorised discounts.
Independent marketing and advertising expenses shall be borne by the respective Channel Partner unless otherwise agreed in writing.
Channel Partners must comply with applicable advertising, real estate and regulatory requirements.
Project management reserves the right to request correction or removal of inaccurate, misleading or legally non-compliant promotional content.
10. Buyer Data Privacy & Confidentiality
Channel Partners must obtain appropriate permission from prospective buyers before collecting and sharing their personal information.
Buyer information must be used only for authorised project enquiries, follow-ups, site visits and sales-related activities.
Channel Partners must maintain the confidentiality of buyer information, project documents and sensitive business information.
Unauthorised disclosure, misuse, sale or transfer of buyer information is prohibited.
Channel Partners must follow applicable data protection requirements and the project's Privacy Notice.
Partners must not share their dashboard login credentials with unauthorised individuals.
11. Channel Partner Responsibilities
Channel Partners must maintain professional and transparent communication with prospective buyers and project representatives.
Partners are responsible for providing accurate and updated buyer information.
Partners should coordinate with the project team for buyer enquiries, site visits and necessary follow-ups.
Partners must act ethically and avoid misleading, fraudulent or unfair sales practices.
Channel Partners must comply with all applicable laws and regulations related to their marketing and sales activities.
12. Independent Channel Partner Relationship
Channel Partners will operate as independent service providers and not as employees of Foothills of Mahabaleshwar or its project management entity.
Registration does not establish an employment, partnership, franchise, agency with general authority, or joint venture relationship.
Channel Partners are free to conduct their independent real estate business activities.
Channel Partners shall not enter into binding agreements or make financial commitments on behalf of the project without written authorisation.
Any entitlement to commission shall arise only under the applicable written agreement.
13. Account Suspension & Termination
Project management may suspend or terminate Channel Partner accounts in cases of fraudulent activity, misleading promotions, data misuse or material violations of these Terms & Conditions.
Where reasonably appropriate, the Channel Partner will be notified of the issue and provided an opportunity to respond.
Immediate suspension may be implemented where necessary to prevent fraud, security risks or legal violations.
Upon termination, access to the Channel Partner Dashboard may be disabled.
Valid commission claims arising before termination will be addressed according to the applicable written agreement.
14. Legal & Regulatory Compliance
Channel Partners must comply with applicable laws governing real estate marketing, agricultural land transactions and property sales in Maharashtra.
Where applicable, Channel Partners must maintain the registrations and authorisations required under MahaRERA or other relevant regulations.
Channel Partners must not misrepresent agricultural land as approved non-agricultural residential land without the necessary permissions.
Any restrictions affecting a buyer's eligibility to purchase agricultural land must be appropriately disclosed and verified.
Channel Partners must not make statements that conflict with official project documentation or applicable laws.
Disputes will be handled in accordance with the governing Channel Partner agreement and applicable Indian law.
15. Acceptance of Terms & Conditions
By submitting the Channel Partner Registration Form, the applicant confirms that all information provided is true and accurate.
The applicant acknowledges having read and understood these Terms & Conditions and the applicable Privacy Notice.
The applicant agrees to follow the project's lead registration, site visit verification, marketing and commission policies.
Project management may update these Terms & Conditions when reasonably required and will communicate material changes to registered Channel Partners.
Changes will not retrospectively override accrued contractual commission rights except as permitted under the applicable agreement and law.
Submission of the registration form constitutes electronic acknowledgement of these Terms & Conditions.

FOOTHILLS OF MAHABALESHWAR
Channel Partner Programme
Poladpur, Raigad, Maharashtra
Note: Commission percentages, lead validity periods, payment milestones and other commercial arrangements will be specified separately in the Channel Partner Commission Agreement.
